name: @kealthas-dev/opencode-council
description: council.ts opencode plugin: a council tool and /council command that put a question to several independent advisors in parallel and have a tool-less synthesizer rate the consensus (unanimous, majority, split). Written in TypeScript against @opencode-ai/plugin's Plugin type (type-only) plus a real zod runtime dependency for the tool's argument schema. Independently installable - not bundled with the other plugins.
